item: An unclean end's thread dump is exported with the crashing thread whole and the top of every other thread and a counted cut
summary: The 10-14 SIGABRT in lxml (trafilatura) exported 60 of 1336 trace lines: the first 60 were the crashing thread and a few idle ones. A cut dump now keeps whatever precedes the first thread, the crashing thread's block, then each other thread's first lines (top frames); the previous session keeps up to 400 lines, the newest earlier end 400, older ends 120. A cut says lines_kept, threads_total, threads_not_listed and a cut_note; lines_total stays the log's own count. The whole body is still scrubbed before any line is chosen.
